config_entries.label: Key
config_entries.description: The key: a single character such as `a`, an X11 key name such as `Return`, `Escape`, `Tab`, `BackSpace`, `Up`, `Down`, `Left`, `Right`, `Page_Up`, `Page_Down`, `Home`, `End`, `Delete`, `F1` to `F12`, `Shift_L`, `Control_L` or `Alt_L`, or a key number (keysym). Names are not case sensitive. A lambda returns the keysym as a number, for example `0xff0d` for `Return`.

config_entries.label: Action
config_entries.description: `press` sends the key down and up. `down` or `up` sends only one of them, for holding keys such as Shift. Defaults to `press`.
